issues.message: Unknown Board is on board 99, which is not in Boards. Add board 99 under Boards (type ACTUATOR, or BALL_VALVE for a motorized ball valve), or move the role.
Ball NO is valve 1 on ball valve board 71, which lists active_connectors []. Add 1 to the board's Active Connectors, or move the role.
Ball NO is on ball valve board 71 and is marked NO. A ball valve has no NO/NC — 1 opens it — so set it to NC.
2 actuators are assigned "pwm_fuel" (PWM One, PWM Two) — exactly one must be.
No actuator is assigned "pwm_ox" — the controller has no ox PWM output. Assign one, or clear the other assignment if this rig does not use the PWM controller.

In the Actuators table but not in [actuator_roles]: Fuel Vent, Fuel Press, Fuel Main, Fuel Fill Vent, Fuel Fill Press, LOX Vent, LOX Press, LOX Main, LOX Dump, LOX Fill, GSE Low Press Vent, GSE High Press Vent, GN2 Vent, GSE LOX Fill Vent, GSE High Press Control, GSE Med Press Control — these rows command nothing.

Configured but missing an Actuators row: Too Short, Lowercase no, Ball NO, Channel Zero, Channel Eleven, Unknown Board, PWM One, PWM Two, PWM Bad, Wrong Types, Not An Array — the sequencer will never command these in any state.
